name: ingham_unemployment_rate
definition_notes: Unemployment rate, Ingham County, MI, not seasonally adjusted. BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics, republished by FRED as MIINGH5URN.

name: ingham_labor_force
definition_notes: Civilian labor force, Ingham County, MI, not seasonally adjusted (FRED MIINGH5LFN).

name: mi_building_permits
definition_notes: New private housing units authorized by building permits, Michigan, not seasonally adjusted (Census Building Permits Survey, FRED MIBPPRIV). State level: FRED has no monthly series for the county or the Lansing metro area.

name: mi_business_applications
definition_notes: Business applications, Michigan, seasonally adjusted (Census Business Formation Statistics, FRED BABATOTALSAMI). Used as the count of new business registrations.

name: ingham_unemployment_rate_bls
definition_notes: The same LAUS series from its original publisher, BLS (series LAUCN260650000000003). BLS serves no plain CSV download, so this signal reads a CSV file that you save at the path in source_spec (columns DATE, VALUE). Until the file exists, each run opens a refresh_failed work item for this signal.
